title: We're going to IIT Bombay — NEC 2026
author: Idea Incubator, MGIT
excerpt: Twenty-two students from MGIT have been selected to represent Idea Incubator at the National Entrepreneurship Challenge 2026 at IIT Bombay, Powai.
content:
We're thrilled to announce that twenty-two students from Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology have earned their place in the delegation travelling to IIT Bombay for the National Entrepreneurship Challenge 2026.

After months of internal ideation rounds, pitch sessions and rigorous selection, these 22 students — spread across seven teams covering Technology, Marketing, Design, Events, PR, Content and Finance — will represent MGIT on a national stage.

NEC is E-Cell IIT Bombay's flagship competition, run across hundreds of campuses nationwide. Teams take an idea from a one-line premise to a defensible business model, then pitch it against the best student founders in the country.

We are incredibly proud of every delegate who made it through, and grateful to our mentors — Prof. G. Chandramohan Reddy, Dr. K. C. Sabitha, and Dr. T. V. Rajinikanth — for their continued support.

Stay tuned to this blog for updates from the journey.
